primary_scope: fixed-target macro-F1 loss remains primary; these are secondary retrospective diagnostics
calibration_CV: 3 stratified source-validation folds; lambda grid .001,.01,.1,1,10; no test tuning
vector_input: centered log probabilities (identical to centered logits up to archived numeric precision)
dirichlet_input: log probabilities; ODIR penalty, equal off-diagonal and intercept lambda selected by source CV
target_reference: five disjoint 20-label calibration folds, each tested on its complement of 80; descriptive repetition, not five independent cohorts or a guaranteed upper bound
CRC: temperature/source-calibration halves split deterministically; prediction-set miscoverage, not selective conditional risk; checkpoint previously selected using full validation; no formal guarantee claimed
calibration_bias: L2 residual variance correction with source-fixed bins; singleton bins reported as undefined, never silently imputed; not an unbiased L1 ECE claim
BCa: fixed seed-mean class F1; class-stratified paired image bootstrap; weighted within-class jackknife preserves class mass
normal_bias_adjusted_L1: five adaptive confidence bins; analytic normal-bootstrap expectation; 2*plugin minus expected absolute gap; signed estimates retained; undefined with singleton bins
calibrator_bounds: diagonal .05..20, offdiagonal/intercept -10..10; L-BFGS-B and documented SLSQP fallback
